content: The TcpIp shall remove entries of the ARP table if they are not used for the timeout specified by the configuratio n parameter TcpIpArpTableEntryTimeout. If TcpIpArpTableEntryTimeout is set to INF , the TcpIp module shall never remove entries from the ARP table.
